rationale: Results exceed expectations; positive signal.

Results fall short of expectations; negative signal.
Third-person/plural form of miss; results miss expectations.

Past tense/participle of upgrade; rating has been raised.
Analyst/rating downgrade; generally adverse for asset prices.
Past tense/participle of downgrade; rating has been lowered.
Performs better than benchmark/market; positive rating.
Third-person form of outperform; beats benchmark.
Performs worse than benchmark/market; negative rating.
Third-person form of underperform; lags benchmark.
Expresses positive market outlook; clearly favourable.
Expresses negative market outlook; clearly adverse.
Share repurchase signals confidence and supports value; occasionally driven by other motives, but broadly positive.
Plural form of buyback; multiple or ongoing repurchases.
Sharp rise in price or operating metrics; strongly positive.
Sharp, steep drop in price or results; strongly negative.
Broad or concentrated selling pressure leading to price falls; negative.
Legal state of insolvency; extreme negative event.
Financially insolvent; unable to pay debts; severe distress.
Inability to meet financial obligations; severe distress, slightly less severe than bankruptcy.
Removal or threatened removal from exchange listing; major negative.
Deep cuts to guidance, workforce, or payouts; clearly adverse.
